dashboard.label: Home Lab SOC - Detection Overview
dashboard.description: Eight MITRE ATT&CK techniques run against victim01, each caught by a purpose-built Splunk detection. github.com/SecByAlii/home-lab-soc

search.query: index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<u>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as n earliest(_time) as et by src _time | where n>=5 | eval _time=et, detection="SSH brute force", mitre="T1110.001", tactic="Credential Access", actor=src, detail=n." failed SSH logins in 5 min" | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "new user:" "svc_backup" | eval detection="New local account", mitre="T1136.001", tactic="Persistence", actor="analyst", detail="useradd svc_backup" | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=syslog "systemd[1]: Starting" "sysupdate-check.service" | stats min(_time) as et | eval _time=et, detection="Unknown systemd service", mitre="T1543.002", tactic="Persistence", actor="analyst", detail="sysupdate-check.service not in known-good baseline" | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "password for " "127.0.0.1" | rex "(?<r>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<acct>\S+) from (?<src>\S+)" | eval et=_time | bin _time span=10m | stats count(eval(r=="Failed")) as fb count(eval(r=="Accepted")) as ok values(acct) as acct min(et) as et by src _time | where fb>=3 AND ok>=1 | eval _time=et, detection="Valid-account login after brute force", mitre="T1078", tactic="Defense Evasion", actor=acct, detail=fb." fails then a success from ".src | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_audit (key=cron_persist OR key=cron_exec) type=SYSCALL | stats min(_time) as et values(comm) as comm by AUID | eval _time=et, detection="Cron persistence", mitre="T1053.003", tactic="Persistence", actor=AUID, detail="cron written via ".mvjoin(comm,", ") | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_audit key=log_tamper type=SYSCALL comm IN ("truncate","rm","dd","shred","bash") | stats min(_time) as et values(comm) as comm by AUID | eval _time=et, detection="System log cleared", mitre="T1070.002", tactic="Defense Evasion", actor=AUID, detail="truncate / rm on log files via ".mvjoin(comm,", ") | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_audit type=EXECVE ("nmap" OR ("ip" AND "neigh")) | eval cmd=mvjoin(mvappend(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4)," ") | search cmd="nmap -sn*" OR cmd="nmap -p*" OR cmd="ip neigh*" | stats min(_time) as et values(cmd) as cmd | eval _time=et, detection="Network scan / discovery", mitre="T1018", tactic="Discovery", actor="analyst", detail=mvcount(cmd)." recon commands (nmap sweep, port scan, ARP)" | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | append [ search index=main sourcetype=linux_audit key=perm_mod type=SYSCALL | rex "\ba2=(?<mh>[0-9a-f]+)" | eval mo=tonumber(mh,16) | where floor(mo/2048)%2==1 OR floor(mo/1024)%2==1 | stats min(_time) as et by AUID | eval _time=et, detection="Setuid bit set on binary", mitre="T1548.001", tactic="Privilege Escalation", actor=AUID, detail="chmod set the setuid bit (mode 04755)" | fields _time detection mitre tactic actor detail ] | table _time detection mitre tactic actor detail

panel.title: Detection timeline — the simulated intrusion, in order

search.query: | sort _time | eval _time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename _time as "Time", detection as "Detection", mitre as "MITRE ID", tactic as "ATT&CK Tactic", actor as "Actor", detail as "What fired it"
| stats count as Detections by tactic | rename tactic as "ATT&CK Tactic" | sort - Detections
| stats values(detection) as "Detection" by mitre tactic | rename mitre as "MITRE ID", tactic as "ATT&CK Tactic" | sort "MITRE ID"
